title: Explicit cohomology coordinates for a supplied affine comparison
statement: For commutative rings A and B, phi : B → A, associated sheaf T [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction], and an ordinary natural isomorphism sigma : res_phi ⋙ T_B ≅ T_A ⋙ f_* with f=Spec(phi), define q_(C,i) on every unbounded A-module complex by inverse exact-homology comparison for res_phi ⋙ T_B, inverse Q/homology comparison, H^i(Q(sigma_C)), and H^i of the actual right-derived unit [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For a representative t:Q(T_A C)≅L define b_(C,t):H^i(C)≅Gamma_A H^i(L) by the tilde unit, Gamma_A of the inverse exact-tilde homology comparison, inverse Q/homology comparison and H^i(t). These are explicit composites, with no witness selected from an existence theorem. The displayed associated sheaf abbreviation denotes precisely Mathlib tilde.

lean.statement:
def affinePushforwardCohomologyMapOfComparison (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : B →+* A)
    (σ : ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ ⋙ affinePushforwardTilde B ≅
      affinePushforwardTilde A ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
    (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (i : ℤ) :
    (affinePushforwardTilde B).obj ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj (C.homology i)) ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of B)).toRingedSpace)) i).obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (((affinePushforwardTilde A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C)))
